name: Ezekiel
author: Ezekiel, a priest living among the exiles.
setting: The exiles in Babylon, before and after Jerusalem’s fall.
theme: God’s glory departs from the temple because of sin, and he promises a new heart and a restored people.

outline.label: The vision of the glory of the LORD
The shepherds and the good shepherd
The vision of the new temple and the return of the glory

christInBook: The good shepherd of chapter 34, the new heart and spirit of chapter 36, and the river from the temple in chapter 47 all point to Christ. Jesus calls himself the good shepherd, and he gives living water.
howToRead: Ezekiel is full of visions and symbolic acts. Watch for the repeated phrase “then they will know that I am the LORD.” The book moves from the departure of God’s glory to its return.
